metadata.question: Does Somalia show lower soil moisture in April 2019 compared to the average April conditions?

data.raw_code: 1. Search strategy: - Collection: NASA SMAP soil moisture (NASA/SMAP/SPL4SMGP/007) or SMOS - Date: April 2019 for current, multiple April months (2015-2024) for average - Location: Somalia country boundary 2. Masking strategy: - Soil moisture data typically doesn't need cloud masking - Focus on valid data availability 3. Logic: - Valid Zero: Soil moisture can be genuinely low (drought condition) - Answer A or B - Null/Error (C3): If calculation returns None/NaN - Empty (C1): If no images found - No Valid Pixels (C2): If pixel count is 0 after processing Compare: April 2019 mean < Historical April mean → Answer A (Yes, lower) Otherwise → Answer B (No, not lower) ```javascript const ee = require('@google/earthengine'); const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); async function runAnalysis() { // 1. Geometry & Time Definitions const somalia = ee.FeatureCollection('USDOS/LSIB_SIMPLE/2017') .filter(ee.Filter.eq('country_na', 'Somalia')) .geometry(); // 2. Data Acquisition const soilMoistureCollection = 'NASA/SMAP/SPL4SMGP/007'; const band = 'sm_surface'; // April 2019 const april2019 = ee.ImageCollection(soilMoistureCollection) .filterDate('2019-04-01', '2019-05-01') .filterBounds(somalia) .select(band); const size2019 = april2019.size().getInfo(); console.log(`April 2019 Images: ${size2019}`); if (size2019 === 0) { console.log("No data for April 2019."); console.log("C1"); return; } // Historical April average (2015-2024, excluding 2019) const years = [2015, 2016, 2017, 2018, 2020, 2021, 2022, 2023, 2024]; let aprilImages = ee.ImageCollection([]); for (let year of years) { const yearCol = ee.ImageCollection(soilMoistureCollection) .filterDate(`${year}-04-01`, `${year}-05-01`) .filterBounds(somalia) .select(band); aprilImages = aprilImages.merge(yearCol); } const sizeHistorical = aprilImages.size().getInfo(); console.log(`Historical April Images: ${sizeHistorical}`); if (sizeHistorical === 0) { console.log("No historical data for April."); console.log("C1"); return; } // 3. Calculate means const mean2019Image = april2019.mean(); const meanHistoricalImage = aprilImages.mean(); // 4. Reduce region with pixel count validation const reducer = ee.Reducer.mean().combine({ reducer2: ee.Reducer.count(), sharedInputs: true }); const stats2019 = mean2019Image.reduceRegion({ reducer: reducer, geometry: somalia, scale: 10000, maxPixels: 1e9 }); const statsHistorical = meanHistoricalImage.reduceRegion({ reducer: reducer, geometry: somalia, scale: 10000, maxPixels: 1e9 }); const mean2019 = stats2019.get(`${band}_mean`).getInfo(); const count2019 = stats2019.get(`${band}_count`).getInfo(); const meanHistorical = statsHistorical.get(`${band}_mean`).getInfo(); const countHistorical = statsHistorical.get(`${band}_count`).getInfo(); console.log(`April 2019: Mean=${mean2019}, Pixels=${count2019}`); console.log(`Historical April: Mean=${meanHistorical}, Pixels=${countHistorical}`); // 5. Validation & Final Answer if (count2019 === 0 || countHistorical === 0) { console.log("No valid pixels after processing."); console.log("C2"); return; } if (mean2019 === null || meanHistorical === null || isNaN(mean2019) || isNaN(meanHistorical)) { console.log("Calculation failed - invalid result."); console.log("C3"); return; } // Compare soil moisture if (mean2019 < meanHistorical) { console.log("April 2019 shows LOWER soil moisture than average."); console.log("A"); } else { console.log("April 2019 does NOT show lower soil moisture than average."); console.log("B"); } } async function initEE() { await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject); }); await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject); }); await runAnalysis(); } initEE(); ```
